detail: Full summary: twining_housekeeping's documented #35 repair path was booby-trapped. compact_archives only does real work under execute:true (housekeeping.ts step 10), but step 1 unconditionally runs archiver.archive() with NO cutoff on any execute:true (housekeeping.ts:143). So the sanctioned way to reclaim 3.58GB of archive-loop junk would first archive the caller's ENTIRE live board. Fixed via archive:false; safe invocation is twining_housekeeping({compact_archives:true, execute:true, archive:false}).
